summary: This bill prevents dental and vision plans from setting prices for non-covered services, restricts their ability to limit choices of labs or suppliers, and requires optometrists and dentists to agree to contract extensions longer than two years, while allowing states to opt out of these requirements.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses healthcare coverage by amending the Public Health Service Act to improve access and terms for vision and dental plans. It focuses on regulating the relationship between providers and plans, which is central to healthcare delivery and financing.
